name: FIAMM
verdict: Owned by AURELIUS, a global private equity investor, since its acquisition from Resonac was completed in December 2025. Nothing found.
note: Sponsor of Prima Pramac Yamaha MotoGP for 2026-2028, with its logo on the bikes' windscreens (FIAMM press release, 19 January 2026). Rating note: AURELIUS Private Equity Mid-Market Buyout completed the acquisition of FIAMM Energy Technology from Resonac on 1 December 2025 (FIAMM press release, fiamm-aurelius-acquisition). No state in the chain; no human-rights finding against FIAMM or Aurelius found (checked 2026-10-03).
